title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical Question Answering on ESC Cardiology Guidelines: Evaluation and Retrieval Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.34427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Large language models produce hallucinations in medical question answering (QA). Verify-and-revise pipelines that check atomic claims against retrieved guideline evidence are a standard mitigation, but evaluations almost universally treat the verifier's output as ground truth, an assumption rarely tested. Objective: To measure, claim by claim against human judgement, how such a pipeline fails in a guideline-grounded clinical setting. Methods: We built a dataset of 160 questions (100 patient vignettes from 89 de-identified cases, 60 fact-based) over four recent ESC cardiology guidelines, all approved by a practising internist, and a retrieval corpus of 627 hand-verified guideline records at two chunk granularities. translated_title: 缓解ESC心脏病学指南医学问答中的幻觉：评估与检索优化
translated_abstract: 背景：大语言模型在医学问答（QA）中会产生幻觉。通过检索指南证据对原子化声明进行核验的“验证-修订”流程是一种标准的缓解手段，但现有评估几乎普遍将验证器的输出视为真值（ground truth），这一假设很少被检验。目标：在基于指南的临床场景中，逐条声明对照人类判断，测量此类流程的失败情况。方法：我们构建了一个包含160个问题的数据集（100个患者病例场景来自89个去标识化病例，60个基于事实的问题），涵盖四份近期ESC心脏病学指南，全部经一名执业内科医生审核；同时建立了一个包含627条人工核验指南记录的检索语料库，采用两种分块粒度。在四种检索配置和三次独立运行（共1920次臂运行）下运行了五阶段流程；所有606条首轮被驳回的声明均经人工审计，一名独立评审员重新判断了906项决策……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次逐条对照人类判断，系统评估了基于ESC心脏病学指南的“验证-修订”流程在医学问答中的实际失败情况，并优化了检索配置以缓解大语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates a verify-and-revise pipeline claim-by-claim against human judgment for medical QA grounded in ESC cardiology guidelines, revealing verification failures and optimizing retrieval configurations to mitigate LLM hallucinations.
